question: Does the exact freestanding Thomas RGB16 PNG core retain host-identical bytes and bounded practical runtime at 12MP on an Android 14 x86_64 virtual device?

fixture.profile: exact P8CM synthetic amplitude, three Thomas fields and identity neutral gauge

development_observation: Before this confirmation contract, one host two-process development run and one Android wipe-data boot with two processes produced identical 72054675-byte PNGs at 6.88-7.80s host and 14.88-15.48s Android. These observations selected no dimension, partition, profile or threshold; 12MP and row partition 128 were inherited from P8CK.
claim_ceiling: Private Android 14 x86_64 virtual-device 12MP execution of one synthetic display-sRGB profile with host-identical PNG bytes; not physical arm64, JNI/app/media integration, calibrated film response, broad device performance or product promotion.
